name: Yokubou Shikkounin
source:
Pretty girl seeping innocently in the train with pants seen. A woman ascending the stairs with a super mini skirt. A nurse at a hospital where the protagonist is hospitalized with trauma of both hands. A girl selling ero doujinshi at the event booth. A waitress at a family restaurant. When main character meets such girls, a wide smile appears on his face covering his desire, and he starts to act.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
电车上天真地睡着露出内裤的可爱女孩。穿着超短裙上楼梯的女人。主人公因双手受伤住院时的护士。在活动摊位上卖色情同人本的女孩。家庭餐厅的女服务员。当主人公遇到这些女孩时，脸上浮现出掩饰欲望的灿烂笑容，然后开始行动。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
